description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for interacting with the coins data in a local database using Room persistence library.

methods.name: getCoins
methods.description: Retrieves a list of coins ordered by their market cap rank.

methods.name: getCoin
methods.description: Retrieves a specific coin by its ID.

methods.name: insertCoins
methods.description: Inserts a list of coins into the database, replacing existing entries on conflict.

methods.name: deleteAllCoins
methods.description: Deletes all coins from the database.

methods.name: deleteOldCoins
methods.description: Deletes coins that have not been updated since the specified timestamp.

methods.name: updateCoins
methods.description: Updates the database with the provided list of coins by first deleting all existing coins and then inserting the new ones.

methods.name: getCoinCount
methods.description: Returns the count of coins in the database.
